"""Source-bound synthetic custody review runner; no archive or entropy access."""
from hashlib import sha256
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT=HERE.parents[2]
LANE=HERE.parent
for path in (HERE,LANE/'scripts'):sys.path.insert(0,str(path))
import mpea_archive_driver as driver


def checksum(path):return sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    version=sys.argv[1]
    if not version.isdigit():raise ValueError('numeric run version required')
    stem='archive-driver-final-v'+version
    log=HERE/(stem+'.txt');receipt_path=HERE/(stem+'.json')
    if log.exists() or receipt_path.exists():raise ValueError('preserve existing run')
    files={Path(module.__file__).resolve() for module in tuple(sys.modules.values())
           if getattr(module,'__file__',None) and str(module.__file__).endswith('.py')
           and ROOT in Path(module.__file__).resolve().parents}
    files.update(HERE/name for name in ('test_archive_case_consistency_initial.py','test_archive_driver_review.py',
        'constructed_archive_case.py','archive_reproduction_fixture.py','test_production_store_review.py','run_driver_review.py'))
    files.update(ROOT/relative for relative in (
        'AGENTS.md','.cache/mpea-protocol-design/mpea-t25-archival-protocol-v1.md',
        '.cache/mpea-protocol-design/mpea-t25-implementation-contract-v1.md',
        '.cache/mpea-operational-addendum/mpea-t25-operational-enforcement-v1.md'))
    files=sorted(files)
    before={str(path.relative_to(ROOT)):checksum(path) for path in files}
    command=[sys.executable,'-m','unittest','discover','-s',str(HERE),'-p','test_archive*.py','-v']
    env=os.environ.copy();env.pop('PYTHONPATH',None);started=time.monotonic()
    with log.open('xb') as stream:
        process=subprocess.run(command,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,cwd=ROOT)
    after={str(path.relative_to(ROOT)):checksum(path) for path in files}
    receipt={'schema':'lupine.discovery.independent_archive_review_run.v1','scope':'synthetic_constructed_inputs_only',
        'actual_scientific_data_read':False,'scientific_entropy_draws':0,'command':command,
        'pythonpath_removed':True,'returncode':process.returncode,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,
        'before':before,'after':after,'changed':[key for key in before if before[key]!=after[key]],
        'log':log.name,'log_sha256':checksum(log)}
    with receipt_path.open('x') as stream:json.dump(receipt,stream,sort_keys=True,indent=2);stream.write('\n')
    print(json.dumps({key:receipt[key] for key in ('returncode','elapsed_seconds','changed','log_sha256')}))
    print(log.read_text())


if __name__=='__main__':main()
